# Workspace instructions

- This project is a React + TypeScript + Vite inventory and sales dashboard with local prototype sign-in and roles.
- Keep interface copy in Kurdish Sorani and preserve right-to-left layout.
- Use the existing white and green visual theme and responsive styles.
- Do not add mock or seeded business records; keep empty states and zero metrics until real data is connected.
- Inventory, account, session, sales, stock movements, price history, expenses, tax remittances, and cash reconciliations are stored by the Express backend in the ignored SQLite database under data/. Password hashing, HttpOnly sessions, and role authorization are server-side; use HTTPS and a shared production database/session store before public multi-device deployment.
